rows.en: I stepped on something. It's like birdlime. It's super sticky!
I stepped on something gooey. Feels like birdlime.
Hey, I stepped in somethin' weird! Damn stuff's sticky as birdlime.
I stepped on something sticky!! Birdlime? ...Is this a Crisis trap!?
I stepped on something! It's like birdlime!
I went and stepped in somethin' gooey. It's just like birdlime.
I stepped on something sticky. Birdlime...?
I stepped on something. It's gooey and nasty... Birdlime?
I stepped on something sticky. Birdlime...?
I stepped on something highly viscous. Birdlime...?
It doesn't look like a trap or anything.
N-Nothing! I'm not scared or anything!
Yeah, I'm fine. It doesn't look like a trap.
Yeah, this much is nothin'. Let's go.
...Yeah. It doesn't seem to be a trap. I can keep going.
...Yes. It doesn't seem to be anything serious.
...Yeah. This much is no problem... Let's go!
...Yeah. It doesn't look like a trap.
...Yeah. It doesn't seem to be a trap... Let's go.
Huh? What was that scream just now...
{8074} and the team peeked into the room the scream was coming from.
A kaijin strapped down to a bed...
Suddenly, a fierce cold wind began to rage, and the temperature all around started to plummet!
Hey, hey! What's going on here!? We already beat him!!
Wha...!? What's going on!? We already beat him!!
Hey, what's going on!? Didn't we beat him already?
Well then, I believe that will be all from me for now.
I'd like you all to get a good, long taste of just how terrifying our science can be.
Waah... That enemy can't seriously be immortal, can it...?
Ugh... What kind of monster is he...!!
Waaah...!! What kind of monster is he...!!
You're... Could you be Kamen Rider 2!?
Hm...!? You... Don't tell me you're Kamen Rider 2!?

notes.note: 0308 #0.1-0.21 and #0.29-0.36, 0310 #0.4-0.19 and #0.25-0.34, 0311 #0.1-0.15 are party-leader variants (only the leader's line plays); labels 'Wing Zero'/'Black RX' on the first variant are not reliable. Tone set from each line's own register: #0.15 (mentions Crisis) is Black RX, #0.16/#0.32 polite (Mebius-type), #0.14/#0.30 rough.
Torimochi rendered 'birdlime' throughout so the joke lands: Ankh is a bird Greeed and panics at it (#0.22, #0.25, #0.26).
Labelled OOO; kept as OOO's reassurance before he notices Ankh's reaction in #0.24.
Ankh asking whoever stepped in it whether they can keep moving; the leader variants #0.29-0.36 answer.

Kaijin kept as 'kaijin' (used earlier in the script). Who is strapped down is not named here; left unidentified (story_045 has Rider 2 rescued from re-modification, but the kaijin may be someone else).
Labelled Ankh but #0.4-0.19 are leader-variant pairs (name, then reaction). 'taoshita hazu' = 'We already beat him!!' (Weather Dopant was defeated earlier in the W arc).
'Fujimi' rendered 'immortal'. #0.25-0.31 and #0.32-0.34 are two sets of leader variants after being hit; the first label 'Black RX' is not reliable.
'2-gou senpai' from a junior Rider: per glossary, Sempai is Imagin-only, so the respect is carried by 'sir'.
Rough leader (Momotaros-style); line continues in story_045 #0.16.

report: 80/80 rows. Most rows are party-leader variants with unreliable speaker labels; tone set from each line's register. 'Torimochi' = 'birdlime' to keep the bird-Greeed joke. 'senpai' Rider address -> 'sir' (#0311 #0.3). No new names.
